description: Complete FreeBSD x86_64 and arm64 kernel vmm source baseline with audited EdgeOS host integration patches.

patches.reason: Re-enter the ARM64 guest after EdgeOS handles a host IRQ instead of translating the host event through the KVM userspace ABI, and clear EdgeOS host-visible per-CPU vCPU slots directly after every vCPU has exited so teardown cannot deadlock behind an interrupt-masked userspace syscall.
Preserve FreeBSD virtual timer filter semantics when EdgeOS host IRQ handling requires a full guest world-switch restore.
Expose an EdgeOS host-only debug-exception exit capability so the Linux KVM guest-debug ABI can receive hardware-breakpoint exits without changing the public bhyve ABI.
Toggle the SVM debug-exception intercept for the EdgeOS KVM hardware-breakpoint bridge while preserving upstream single-step handling.
Toggle the VMX debug-exception bitmap for the EdgeOS KVM hardware-breakpoint bridge and expose the existing interrupt-mask capability state for transactional rollback.

Complete INIT and SIPI through an EdgeOS KVM bridge hook because EdgeOS exposes the Linux KVM ABI and has no bhyve userspace process to consume VM_EXITCODE_SPINUP_AP, and execute the spin-locked vLAPIC timer callout directly because EdgeOS cannot run the cooperative FreeBSD softclock worker while a hardware vCPU remains inside KVM_RUN.
